name: Kettlebell Single-Arm Row
description: Hinged forward with your free hand on your hip, row the kettlebell from below your shoulder up to your hip, then lower it.

source.title: Bent-Over Row (ACE Exercise Library)
source.note: The one-arm kettlebell version, described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Hinge forward with a flat back; free hand on your hip (or on a bench or your thigh for support).
cues: Lead with the elbow, close to your side.

prescription.note: Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower. Start with a light bell.

keyframes.name: Arm hanging
keyframes.cue: Hinge forward, the bell hanging below your shoulder, your other hand on your hip.

keyframes.name: Row
keyframes.cue: Pull the bell to your hip, elbow close to your side.
